title: 第9章 原来是你第10章 仙灵体
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
随着时间流逝，慕容仙儿也熟悉了九州大陆，更熟悉了北宣学院的各位。
这一日慕容仙儿准备去还梦深魇试试运气，说不定能有机遇，于是只身来到深魇后进入绝地。
就在慕容仙儿进入还梦深魇后不久，一道染血身影也坠入其中，此人正是左丘辰...
“噗。”
一道白光闪过，大蛇被白光从颈部斩断，在大蛇头部脱离身体时候，鲜血都没喷出，可见那道白光之快。
黑色大蛇的头颅从蛇身分开，然后下坠入还梦深魇，慕容仙儿转头看去，只见蛇头落入一片黑暗中，半响都没传出动静。
“都已经三千多米了，这鬼地方真的没底吗？”
抱怨声来自慕容仙儿，貌如天仙的脸上挂起一丝忧愁。
而此刻巨大的蛇身抖动，黑色血液喷出，滴滴黑色血液也是落入深魇。
“滋滋滋~~~”
当黑色血液遇到深魇中黑气时候，怪响传来，慕容仙儿抬头看着这诡异的一幕。
黑色血液被黑气吞噬掉后，黑气居然变得更加立体，居然在空中如蛇般扭动起来。
“阴寒之地生出了这些黑暗生物，看似吞噬，实则本是一体的。”
慕容仙儿手中灵剑斩断扭动的黑气言道，果然这个地方非比寻常。
半个时辰后，深魇内一处如星如钻般刺眼，所有黑气都被那亮光阻挡开来，亮光内的少女也是无比谨慎。
因为此刻她放眼望去尽是一片黑暗，头顶更是像被一个漆黑的大锅盖给盖住。
慕容仙儿已经下行了五千米处了，但是深魇就像一个无底洞，没有人知道深入多少米是底部，也没有人知道里面有何生物，世间只说这里是绝地，是不详之地。
双眼四处打量，同时慕容仙儿也放慢了脚步，脸上的冷漠显得她格外严肃。
“咚~”
脚尖碰触到一物，随后发出声响，低头看去，即便慕容仙儿也是大吃一惊。

因为一颗巨大的人形骷髅印入她眼中，说是人形，但却比人的头颅大上数十倍，且那个巨大骷髅居然是漆黑色，不知道已经被黑气腐蚀了多少年，难怪慕容仙儿这么谨慎都没看见。
慕容仙儿暗道虚惊一场，正欲转身离去，突然觉得那巨大骷髅内好似有什么东西存在。
小心翼翼的，按捺不住心中的好奇心，慕容萱儿点点靠近黑色骷髅，抬头顺势望去。
“还算没白来。”
只见黑色骷髅内一根黑色铁棒从左耳贯穿到右耳，横立在骷髅内，慕容萱儿眼带喜色，伸手就要取出此物。
洁白的玉手碰触到漆黑铁棒时候，一股寒意袭来，即便是慕容仙儿也是一惊，巨大的骷髅双眼顿时冒着绿光射来，后者轻盈的双脚猛蹬骷髅后顺势掠出。
“闯入地狱者，死！”
魇内深处传来恐怖的声音，紧接着峭壁上无数绿光亮起，幽幽的绿光如一盏盏明灯照亮慕容仙儿所在。
“有什么了不起，不就是养灵阵吗？”
慕容仙儿没有被这突变镇住，反而带着不屑看着四周。
当整个峭壁被绿光布满时，白衣胜雪的女子不为所动，只是低头看去，下一刻嘴角升起一丝无奈，果然如她所想。
“哎...还是深不见底，这只是第一个悬台。”
“试图进入地狱者，死！”
content_en:
As time passed, Murong Xianer also became familiar with Jiuzhou Continent, and even more familiar with everyone at Beixuan College.
On this day, Murong Xianer planned to go to Deep Nightmare to try her luck, maybe there would be an opportunity, so she came to Deep Nightmare alone to enter the Jedi.
Not long after Murong Xian'er entered the deep nightmare, a blood-stained figure also fell into it. This person was Zuo Qiuchen...
"Pfft."
A white light flashed, and the big snake was cut off from the neck by the white light. When the big snake's head separated from the body, no blood spurted out, which shows how fast the white light was.
The big black snake's head separated from the snake's body, and then fell into the deep nightmare. Murong Xian'er turned around and saw the snake's head falling into darkness, and no movement was heard for a while.
"It's already more than three thousand meters away. Is there really no bottom in this damn place?"
The complaint came from Murong Xian'er, and a trace of sadness appeared on her face, which looked like a fairy.
At this moment, the huge snake body shook, black blood spurted out, and drops of black blood also fell into the deep nightmare.
“Zizzizi~~~”
When the black blood met the black energy in the deep nightmare, a strange sound was heard, and Murong Xianer looked up at this strange scene.
After the black blood was swallowed up by the black energy, the black energy actually became more three-dimensional, twisting like a snake in the air.
"These dark creatures were born in the cold place. They seem to be devouring them, but they are actually one."
Murong Xianer cut off the twisting black energy with the spiritual sword in her hand and said, Sure enough, this place is extraordinary.
Half an hour later, a spot in the deep nightmare was as dazzling as a star, and all the black energy was blocked by the bright light. The girl in the bright light was also extremely cautious.
Because at this moment, all she could see was darkness, and the top of her head seemed to be covered by a dark cauldron lid.
Murong Xian'er has descended five thousand meters, but the deep nightmare is like a bottomless pit. No one knows how many meters deep it is to the bottom, and no one knows what creatures are inside. The world only says that this is a Jedi, an unknown place.
With her eyes looking around, Murong Xian'er also slowed down her pace, and the indifference on her face made her look particularly serious.
"Dong~"
The tip of her toe touched something and then made a sound. When she lowered her head and looked down, even Murong Xianer was shocked.
Because a huge human-shaped skull was imprinted in her eyes. It was said to be human-shaped, but it was dozens of times larger than a human head. Moreover, the huge skull was actually pitch black and had been corroded by the black air for who knows how many years. No wonder Murong Xianer was so cautious and didn't see it.
Murong Xianer secretly gave a false alarm and was about to turn around and leave when she suddenly felt that there seemed to be something inside the huge skeleton.
Cautiously, unable to restrain her curiosity, Murong Xuan approached the black skull and looked up.
"It's not in vain."
Inside the black skull, a black iron rod was seen running from the left ear to the right ear, standing horizontally inside the skull. Murong Xuan'er's eyes were filled with joy, and she reached out to take out the object.
When the white jade hand touched the dark iron rod, a chill hit him. Even Murong Xian'er was startled. The huge skull's eyes suddenly shot out with green light. The latter's light feet kicked the skull hard and flew out.
"Those who invade hell will die!"
A terrifying sound came from the depths of the nightmare, and then countless green lights lit up on the cliff. The faint green lights illuminated Murong Xian'er's location like bright lights.
"What's so great about it, isn't it the spirit nourishing array?"
Murong Xianer was not calmed by this sudden change, but looked around with disdain.
When the entire cliff was filled with green light, the woman in white clothes and snow was unmoved. She just looked down and felt helpless at the corner of her mouth at the next moment. It was just as she thought.
"Hey...it's still bottomless. This is just the first suspended platform."
"Those who try to enter hell will die!"
